narrative.headline: Inspect Japan rail-ticket conditions and linked official operator rules with explicit uncertainty.
narrative.value_prop: Discover a bounded regional ticket shortlist, read the linked official operator document, and compare source periods and conditions. Japanese evidence, independent source clocks, conflicts and unknowns stay visible.
narrative.auth_narrative: Ordinary anonymous public Toretabi and linked official operator documents; no credentials or running browser.

quickstart.comment: Inspect publisher facts and bounded linked official operator rules.
Compare published date evidence without assuming seat stock.

troubleshoots.symptom: No matches in a bounded listing
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect coverage and widen --max-pages within its limit.

troubleshoots.symptom: Price or date match is unknown
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect ticket.operator.status, rule_checks and unresolved. Missing, inaccessible or ambiguous operator evidence cannot verify a rule.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Toretabi regional ticket discovery, bounded linked official rule inspection and a small dated comparison. Separate publisher and operator evidence, purchase dates, use dates and unresolved eligibility; cached records retain both original clocks.
anti_triggers: Bookings, payments, messages or account writes
Tourist-train operating timetables or live seats
Whole-site articles or archive edition discovery outside /ticket/
